adjudication.rationale: In Office365CalendarService the diff replaces `refreshTokenResponseSchema.safeParse(responseJson)` with `parseRefreshTokenResponse(responseJson, refreshTokenResponseSchema)`. `parseRefreshTokenResponse` throws if `safeParse` fails (`if (!refreshTokenResponse.success) { throw new Error(...) }`), so the code will not proceed to spread `tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data` or persist anything on parse failure. The removed `console.error` therefore does not cause silent persistence of incomplete credentials as claimed.
